snippet.title: Crosscountry USA 2 Longplay
snippet.description:
Crosscountry USA 2 Longplay

Crosscountry USA is a game created by Didatech Software Ltd. in 2002. It is the sequel to the first Crosscountry USA game. This game teaches Children ages 4-9 the geography of the USA. Unlike the first game, it includes a laptop and a cell phone. This is uploaded in honour of the 4th of July despite the COVID-19 pandemic, and hopefully people will watch this and obey social distancing rules.
